native_reobservation.source_selection_rule: Before-only insufficient evidence at actual step16, fixed visual_occlusion cause, existing train/val states10/13, lexical native CID0. Do not inspect any next-block future to choose the sources.
native_reobservation.source_phase: After one complete native 16-action block from the original shared root; before the next native block. Exact source pose is audited from the actual causal prefix, not inferred from stage or simulated contact.

target_binding_required.task_language: put the black bowl on the plate
target_binding_required.instance_semantics: Private simulator instance/visual-geom mapping is a supervision association only. Before and after availability additionally require actual RGB texture, causal correspondences and registration for this same target. A bare task ID or render-area count cannot certify identity.

execution_order: Read-only verify every frozen dependency and source input hash; validate literal numeric and Boolean QC fields.

Reset and restore each original source snapshot through the frozen historical restore; execute its exact immutable 16 applied actions once. Verify actual dual-RGB and proprio against every historical real step1..16. Never use cached step0/1 to establish before evidence.

Capture a NEW complete post-block simulator/controller runtime snapshot. Restore through the independently tested solver-order wrapper, require every saved runtime field bitwise equal, and validate the same actual RGB/proprio source state. Preserve persistent primary occlusion.

Audit target-bound BEFORE availability solely from actual source step16 and causal prefix evidence plus existing prefix-only repeat QC. A changed available before, unbound target, missing QC, failed registration, or failed source replay stops before any new Cosmos query.

Only after both source gates pass, query real Cosmos K=4 from each actual post-block observation. No hand-created HOLD/PEEK actions, edits to native gripper, requery, best-of-n filtering or selective candidate replacement.

Freeze each native candidate action array, same-query predicted dual-RGB, value, seed, query input hash and raw46 before executing it. Every main and its one QC execution reset and restore the SAME new source snapshot through the SAME exact full-runtime restore wrapper.

Execute the native first 16 actions once and the same candidate once for QC; save all actual frames/proprio/actions plus private Y-only measurements. A short, failed or unobservable candidate is retained without padding or replacement.

Report availability@16 and per-step availability masks, target identity, actual RGB/projection correspondence and same-candidate QC. Endpoint future evidence cannot backfill before or earlier deadlines. Stop at audit; no fit, no source change and no expanded collection.

budget.prefix_QC: Use already-frozen same-candidate source repeat evidence, restricted to original real steps1..16; no extra prefix execution hidden in this budget.
budget.adapter_note: The old AUX replay wrapper performs TWO QC executions and must not be called as if it were a single QC. New collector must explicitly account for exactly one repeat, or fail before launch.

X_contract.Cosmos_input: Actual current dual RGB + observed robot proprio + exact cached task text, all captured before the native query. No actual candidate-after image.
X_contract.canonical_raw46: 14 command features + 16 predicted visual values with 16 literal availability bits; only the same native candidate's actions and same-query predicted images, with current pre-query actual images for predicted deltas.
X_contract.historical_raw46: A zero route-weighted vector cannot identify missing visual fields. Only hash-bound original preexecution allowlisted proxies can reconstruct its availability; missing fields stay missing and zero proxy is not proof of a negative.

release_native_cache_reuse_readonly.future_required_phase_contract: Prior actually certified carrying/held target, receptacle/placement relation certified before release, actual opening and all-hand separation after; private contact/constraints are Y only. Hidden finger/palm or missing carrying baseline leaves release supervision masked.
